title: Ledger entry
description: One entry of the evidence ledger, lab.ledger.jsonl at the main checkout (not committed). One JSON object per line; entries append, including permanent delete tombstones. A confirmed full history reset clears it after deleting all live evidence and history. See lab/lib/ledger.mjs and lab/lib/storage.mjs.

sha256.description: row: the sha256 of the row's line in raw.jsonl, newline included.

reason.description: halt: why the run stopped (left_workdir, write_failed).

status.description: close: the status written to run.json.

halted.description: close: how the run was halted, if it was.

files.description: close, adopt: sha256 of every file of the run folder but scores/. resume: the run's files but run.json, raw.jsonl and harness-events.ndjson. row: the files that call wrote or changed. scores: sha256 of each scores/ file the score command wrote (adopt: every scores/ file of the run's evaluators).

lines.description: close, adopt, resume: the sha256 of each line of raw.jsonl kept, in order.

core.description: open, resume: sha256 of run.json without status, finished_at, runner, notes and the halted, version_end and workdir_git_fence settings.

by.description: adopt: who vouched for the run.

events.description: row, resume: the size and sha256 of the first bytes of harness-events.ndjson that the ledger vouches for (after that row's events).
